messages:
Liam (Marketing): kicking off prep for Orion Diagnostics case study + launch webinar. goal: customer story page + 30m webinar. need interview, quote approvals, legal signoff, assets, routing.
Rina (Sales): Orion agreed to a 20m recorded interview Fri 11am PT. speaker = Head of Data Science (Avery). I'll confirm logo permission.
Taro (Customer Success): Avery prefers recorded audio + slides. wants marketing to avoid clinical examples with patient data.
Liam (Marketing): noted. can we get two impact bullets for the landing hero? e.g., 'infer latency down X' and 'cost per inference down Y%'.
Taro (Customer Success): pulling numbers from our monitoring dashboard. rough: 60% lower p95 latency after batching + 28% cost savings with 8-bit quantization. will confirm.
Maya (Product): I can prepare a tiny reproducible snippet using the exact Redwood SDK call they used. want to include a config YAML in the appendix?
Liam (Marketing): yes include YAML and a one-liner about switching to Dedicated + KV prefix caching. keep the doc friendly to engineers and execs.
Jules (Growth): for registration lead routing, Sales wants fields: company size, deployment intent (prod/poC), cloud region. also a checkbox for 'request sales contact'.
Rina (Sales): HubSpot mapping: please tag every sign-up with "orion-launch" and map checkbox -> owner assignment.
Liam (Marketing): draft quote for approval from customer (please check): 
"Redwood reduced our inference 95th percentile latency by 60% and cut inference costs by 28% after migrating to Dedicated and applying KV prefix caching."
Taro (Customer Success): accurate but suggest we ask if they'd prefer 'about 60%' vs exact 60.
Liam (Marketing): good call. Rina can you ask during the interview to confirm exact phrasing and whether they want a technical quote vs exec quote?
Rina (Sales): will confirm. also looping in their PR contact Claire (c.claire@oriondx.com) for logo and approval.
Priya (Legal): checklist from Legal: (1) signed marketing release (2) confirm no PHI or HIPAA risk (3) logo usage per their brand guide (4) export controls if any model/data transferred. I can do a 24-48h turnaround once release signed.
release-bot: Marketing release created: MR-7819. Status: waiting for customer signature.
Liam (Marketing): we should prepare two quote options for the interview: short + technical. examples: 
- Short: "Redwood made our inference fast and much cheaper."
- Technical: "After enabling prefix caching and switching to mixed-precision quantization, we saw a 3.5x throughput increase and ~28% per-inference cost reduction."
Priya (Legal): technical is okay but avoid unverified absolutes. capture exact phrasing live and send redline to customer for signoff.
Taro (Customer Success): customer confirmed no PHI will be used. they provided a sanitized sample log we can include as an illustration (no patient IDs).
Maya (Product): for the demo clip, do we want a short recorded screen share of the integration or a sandbox playback? Recorded integration is better for authenticity.
Liam (Marketing): recorded integration + a 90s prepped clip. Maya can produce; need the final perf numbers first.
Maya (Product): I can produce the clip in 72h after I get the confirmed numbers.
Jules (Growth): timeline: interview Fri -> internal review Mon -> legal signoff by Wed -> publish + webinar Thu (goal). is that realistic?
Priya (Legal): 48h turnaround is possible but depends on quick customer signature. if they sign same day, Wed signoff ok.
Rina (Sales): I'll nudge Claire after the interview for signature.
Liam (Marketing): A/B subject lines for the webinar email: 
A: "How Orion Diagnostics cut inference latency by 60%"
B: "Behind the scenes: scaling inference at Orion Diagnostics + Redwood"
Jules (Growth): we'll run 50/50 split and track CTR.
Liam (Marketing): inbound automation: Zapier -> HubSpot -> Owner assign. tag mapping: company_size, deployment_intent, region, orion-launch. Jules, can you set the nurture flow?
Jules (Growth): on it. nurture steps: registration confirmation -> 24h reminder -> post-webinar summary w/ case study PDF -> CTA to book sales call.
Rina (Sales): Sales wants a separate list for customers with 'prod' intent to fast-track SDR outreach. map that in HubSpot.
Priya (Legal): final note: avoid including exact model weights or customer proprietary configs in the public case study. technical appendix can be high-level only; link to a private repo if customer agrees.
Liam (Marketing): acknowledged. we'll keep appendix high-level.
Taro (Customer Success): uploading the perf spreadsheet to the shared folder now.
Liam (Marketing): great. after the interview I'll post the transcript and three proposed pull-quotes here for quick approval: Marketing -> Legal -> Customer. target total turnaround <= 6 business days.
release-bot: Reminder: MR-7819 pending signature. Auto-nudge scheduled in 36 hours if unsigned.
Rina (Sales): signed release came in from Claire at 2025-06-10 09:12 PT (uploading).
Priya (Legal): received. starting review now, ETA 24h.
Liam (Marketing): thanks team. once legal clears, we'll finalize landing copy, social blurbs, and the webinar page. :rocket:
